input.quote: Kubient hereby grants to Customer a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable license to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient,
input.rationale: The grant in paragraph 2 is expressly "revocable" with no qualification, so on its face Kubient may revoke at its discretion (paragraph 4(c)(ii) only confirms revocation on termination; it does not limit revocation to that event). The grant names only Customer — no AP affiliates or contractors — and paragraph 8(a) affirmatively bars third-party access to the Service absent Kubient's prior written approval, leaving no path to add them. That combination (revocable at Vendor's discretion plus affiliates/contractors excluded with no path to add) is the rule's walk-away case and fails the fallback, which requires at minimum affiliate coverage on notice. The transfer prong is largely satisfied outside the grant: paragraph 14(h) permits assignment of the Agreement to an affiliate or M&A successor, though the grant itself remains "non-transferable, non-assignable". Redline extends the licence to affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf (with AP remaining responsible for their compliance), limits revocation to expiration or termination under paragraph 4, and conforms transferability to paragraph 14(h).

proposal.summary: Extend the Auction Platform licence to AP affiliates and contractors, remove at-will revocability, and permit transfer to a successor.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We extended the licence to our affiliates and to contractors acting on our behalf, tied revocation to expiration or termination under paragraph 4 rather than Kubient's discretion, and aligned transferability with the assignment right in paragraph 14(h). A licence that is revocable at will and excludes affiliates and contractors is not workable for us operationally.

ops.oldText: Kubient hereby grants to Customer a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable, non-assignable, without right of sublicense, revocable license to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient,
ops.newText: Kubient hereby grants to Customer, its affiliates and its contractors acting on its behalf a limited, royalty-free, non-exclusive license, without right of sublicense, transferable to a successor in accordance with paragraph 14(h) and revocable only upon expiration or termination of this Agreement in accordance with paragraph 4, to access, participate in and use to the full extent the Auction Platform as hosted by Kubient,

ops.oldText: Customer agrees that it will not transfer or (unless expressly and specifically approved by Kubient in advance and in writing) allow third-party access to the Service.
ops.newText: Customer agrees that it will not transfer or (unless expressly and specifically approved by Kubient in advance and in writing) allow third-party access to the Service, other than access by Customer's affiliates and contractors acting on Customer's behalf as permitted under paragraph 2, for whose compliance with this Agreement Customer shall remain responsible.
